title: Wedge of a C^∞ 1-form field with a test form: α∧ω ∈ D^{m+1}(U) for ω ∈ D^m(U)
statement: For all P, m ∈ ℕ, every U ⊆ ℝ^P, every test form ω ∈ D^m(U) (TestFormOn U m: ω is C^∞, has compact support and tsupport ω ⊆ U) and every C^∞ map α : ℝ^P → (ℝ^P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (a smooth field of continuous linear functionals), there is a test form η ∈ D^{m+1}(U) with η(x) = alternatizeUncurryFin((α(x)).smulRight(ω(x))) (that is, η(x) = α(x)∧ω(x)) for every x ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (ω : TestFormOn U m) (α : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ)), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) α → ∃ η : TestFormOn U (m + 1), ∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) x = ContinuousAlternatingMap.alternatizeUncurryFin ((α x).smulRight ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x))
